page.layout: One page of text, no marginal notes. Running head at top with page number at top right. Top: verse lines in a block. Then a section heading with its number, and one paragraph of running text. Catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: Propter quæ scelera, celfo synodum sacra Petri Me uelut indignum depulit e folio. Pontifices igitur moniti sint temporis huius, Exemplo nostro, ne sacra dent precio.
main_text.head: 151. MARTINVS quintus.
main_text.p: Martinus quintus, patria Romanus, Otho Columna prius nuncupatus, D. Georgij diaconus Cardinalis, concilij Constantiensis authoritate, ab rogatis tribus Papis, Benedicto, Gregorio, & Iohanne, Pontifex creabatur. Is enim à teneris annis parentum cura moribus & literis imbutus, vbi ad doleuisset, iuri Pontificio Perusij operam dedit. Vnde ad urbem rediens, & pro uulpe agnum induens, Vrbani sexti referendarius factus est: quod munus simulata manfuetudine ita gessit, ut Cardinalis ab Innocentio septimo ordinatus fit. In omni enim controuersia, aut in utramq; partem alteratione, propter diuersarum factionum studia, relicta ueritate, medium quoddam, ut omnibus pareret, adulator tenuit. Hanc ob rem & imperatori & Cardinalibus omnibus gratus, in prædicto Concilio Papa constituebatur. In cuius electione effusu gaudio Sigismundus Cæsar, omnibus gratias egit, quod talem elegissent pontificem: & eius osculatus est pedes, in eo draconè adorans, Apoc.13. Quæ[?]

page.notes: The first word of the last line, "Què" at the right of the line, is read as Quæ with a doubtful ligature. Its position at line end and the catchword "Ponti" make it uncertain whether it is text or a catchword. The signature "c 4" is doubtful. Long s is written as plain s. Some ff-type letters are read as ss, e.g. "doleuisset". The printed "celfo" and "Co / lumna" line break are kept as read.
